{
  "cases": [
    {
      "question": "所有有效订单的总销售金额是多少？",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "计算 orders 表中 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的所有订单的 paid_amount 总和。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "aggregation:sum:paid_amount:orders:valid_order",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT SUM(paid_amount) FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped');",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "统计各城市的付费用户数，按数量从高到低排序。",
      "category": "top_k",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "对每个城市，统计在有效订单中出现过的唯一 user_id 数量，并按该数量降序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "top_k:city:paying_users:orders_users:valid_order_desc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT u.city, COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS paying_users FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY paying_users DESC;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "列出所有在售商品的品牌与所属类目。",
      "category": "filtering",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "从 products 表中筛选 is_active = 1 的商品，返回其 brand 和 category 字段。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "filtering:products:is_active:brand_category",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT DISTINCT brand, category FROM products WHERE is_active = 1;",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "近30天内（以2026-09-12为基准）各品类的销售金额和退款金额。",
      "category": "join",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "以2026-09-12为参考日，统计过去30天（含）内有效订单对应的商品类目销售金额，以及同期已批准退款的对应类目退款金额。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "join:category:sales_refund:orders_items_products_refunds:valid_order_approved_30d",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT p.category, COALESCE(SUM(oi.item_amount), 0.00) AS sales_amount, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0.00) AS refund_amount FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') AND o.order_date >= DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY p.category;",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "手机数码类目的产品退款率是多少？",
      "category": "refund",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "计算手机数码类目下，已批准退款金额占该类目有效订单商品销售金额的比例。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "refund:rate:category:手机数码:valid_order_approved",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0.00) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.item_amount), 0) AS refund_rate FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') AND p.category = '手机数码';",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "各支付方式的有效订单数和总销售金额。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "按 payment_method 分组，统计有效订单数量及对应 paid_amount 总和。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "aggregation:count_sum:payment_method:orders:valid_order",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(paid_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY payment_method;",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "哪些用户的注册日期早于2025年1月1日且至少下过一单有效订单？",
      "category": "filtering",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "找出 users 表中 register_date < '2025-01-01' 且在 orders 表中有至少一条有效订单记录的 user_id 和 user_name。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "filtering:users_register_orders:early_user_valid_order",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id, u.user_name FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE u.register_date < '2025-01-01' AND o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped');",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "每种退款原因的批准退款次数。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "统计 refunds 表中 refund_status = 'approved' 的记录按 refund_reason 分组的计数。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "aggregation:count:refund_reason:refunds:approved",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT refund_reason, COUNT(*) AS count FROM refunds WHERE refund_status = 'approved' GROUP BY refund_reason;",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "2026年8月各品牌的销售金额排名前5。",
      "category": "top_k",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "统计2026年8月（order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'）内各品牌在有效订单中的商品销售金额总和，取前5名。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "top_k:brand:sales_amount:orders_items_products:valid_order_aug2026_desc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT p.brand, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS sales_amount FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 5;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "VIP客户在有效订单中的平均下单数量（按订单数）。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "计算所有 VIP 客户（users.is_vip = 1）在有效订单中产生的订单总数，再除以其唯一用户数，得到人均订单数。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "aggregation:avg_order_count_per_vip:users_orders:valid_order",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS avg_orders_per_vip FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE u.is_vip = 1 AND o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped');",
      "ordered": false
    }
  ]
}
